label: AB2C6_tP18_113_c_2c_3e-001
title: Tetragonal FeNb$_{2}$O$_{6}$ Structure
comments:
FeNb$_{2}$O$_{6}$ can also be found as \href{current_web_home_dir/AB2C6_oP36_60_c_d_3d-001}{columbite, $E5_{1}$}. 
 The (2c) sites are all combinations of iron and niobium with compositions Fe$_{0.43}$Nb$_{57}$, Fe$_{0.39}$Nb$_{0.61}$ and Fe$_{0.18}$Nb$_{0.82}$, respectively.  We arbitrarily list the first one as Fe and the second and third as Nb to preserve the stoichiometry.
